pages.title: Nerakyss
pages.text: $(bold)The kraken trident, its cannon, the undying tentacle and the trident. Needs Sirok as well.$(br2)$(thing)The Nether$(n), ring 8.$(br)$(thing)34 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Skor and Sirok.
